steps.body: On the chart, ten more is straight below; ten less is straight above. Ten more than 31 is 41 — the ones stay 1.
steps.narration: On the chart, ten more is straight below; ten less is straight above. Ten more than thirty-one is forty-one — the ones stay one.

commonErrors.feedback: That added ONE. Ten more changes the tens: 45 → 55.
That went ten LESS. Ten more counts up: 45 → 55.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Ten more than 45 is 55 — the 5 stays.

predict.prompt: Ten more than 45 — which digit will change?
predict.reveal: Ten more is one whole row down — the tens digit climbs by one while the ones digit doesn't budge. The one exception is a full tens digit: ten more than 90 rolls the 9 over and makes 100, ten tens bundled into a hundred.

explanationVariants: Ten less than 63 is 53 — the tens drop by one, the 3 stays.
Count back a whole ten from 63 to 53.

commonErrors.feedback: That took away ONE. Ten less changes the tens: 63 → 53.
That went ten MORE. Ten less counts back: 63 → 53.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Ten less than 63 is 53 — the 3 stays.

steps.body: Ten more keeps the ones digit and grows the tens. That's why 45 and 55 both end in 5. Only the tens change.
steps.narration: Ten more keeps the ones digit and grows the tens. That's why forty-five and fifty-five both end in five. Only the tens change.

widget.prompt: Match each number to TEN MORE than it.

pairErrors.feedback: Ten more than 7 is 17 — the 7 stays. 44 is ten more than 34.
Ten more than 34 is 44. 17 is ten more than 7.

widget.missFeedback: Keep the ones, add a ten: 17, 44, 90.

explanationVariants: Ten more keeps the ONES digit — 34 and 44 both end in 4.
Adding ten grows the tens but the ones digit holds.

widget.prompt: When you add ten to 34, what stays the same?

options.label: the ones digit (4)
options.feedback: Yes — 34 and 44 both end in 4; only the tens grew.

options.label: the tens digit
options.feedback: The tens CHANGE (3 → 4). The ones digit 4 is what stays.

options.label: both digits
options.feedback: The tens change from 3 to 4. Only the ones digit (4) stays.

explanationVariants: Ten more than 58 is 68, not 59 — a whole ten, not one.
Adding ten changes the tens digit: 58 → 68.

options.feedback: Yes — add a whole ten: 58 → 68, the 8 stays.
That's one more, not ten more. Ten more is 68.
That's ten LESS. Ten more counts up: 58 → 68.

hints: Add a whole ten, not one.

explanationVariants: Ten more than 90 is 100 — the tens roll into a hundred.

commonErrors.feedback: That added ONE. Ten more than 90 reaches 100.
That went ten LESS. Ten more counts up: 90 → 100.

takeaways: Ten more/less changes the tens digit.
The ones digit stays the same.
Don't confuse it with one more/less.
steps.teaser: next: mixing one and ten jumps together.

concept.body: Slow down. Ten more than 20 is 30. Ten less than 20 is 10. The ones stay 0; only the tens change.
concept.narration: Slow down. Ten more than twenty is thirty. Ten less than twenty is ten. The ones stay zero; only the tens change.

explanationVariants: Ten more than 20 is 30 — a whole ten up.
Add a ten to 20 to reach 30.

commonErrors.feedback: That added ONE. Ten more than 20 is 30.
That went ten LESS. Ten more counts up: 20 → 30.
